method: Cut grid: pads cut first (every 5 m point inside footprint + 1.5 m takes the pad level); then every point within half the road width + 3.5 m of any
centre line takes the level of the nearest centre-line point (all roads together). Grades are read along each centre line every 1 m, bilinear on that grid.

R6.limit: every junction on a level landing of 20 m or more
